historical_record.description: The Recreation and Park Commission referred Schubart and Friedman's plans for enclosing the merry-go-round at the Children's Quarters with sash to its committee and staff, asking that the panels be of Plexiglass as far as possible and divided small against breakage; it had approved the architects' agreement for the enclosure, repairs and painting in February (Resolution 5173).

The Recreation and Park Commission approved repainting the Carrousel building's exterior and replacing its panels, largely by Hyatt Corporation volunteers with materials raised by San Francisco Beautiful and Friends of Recreation and Parks; the park committee favored a light plum, with the Arts Commission to settle the colors.

Having bought out the private interests in the merry-go-round, the donkey rides and the restaurant at the Children's Quarters, the Park Commissioners put a permanent cover of antique design over the merry-go-round, built under the supervision of the architect A. Page Brown.
